utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s really picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and spare parts all afternoon. If you’re heading over, I’d go soon before the best stuff gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’m on my way soon — thanks for keeping track of everything. If anything’s still needed, just let me know and I’ll coordinate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if they post the next workday or need anything else. Go soon, and you should still catch the good stuff by the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — just send me the urgent repairs and the time window, and I’ll head over if they’re underway.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I’ll send you the urgent repairs and the time window, and I’m still aiming for around 8:30 Saturday so it stays before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — 8:30 Saturday works for me. Send the list when you can, and I’ll grab what fits.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Anytime after 4 still works — I’ll swing by and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm the exact spot, too? I just want to make sure I head to the right place after 4.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — head to my place on Maple, and I’ll be there after 4. If you get turned around, just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning works for me too—8:30 sounds great, and I can still make school pickup. What time should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 8:30 works — let’s meet then at the spot by the mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll meet you by the mailbox at 8:30.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll head to the front doors first and get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll head there as soon as I can. If anything changes, I’ll text you so you’re not waiting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — I’ll start on the front doors and keep an eye out for the faucet too. Text me if the plan shifts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m still sorting the broken-things list and matching each repair with someone. After that I’ll check what tools we need and pick a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — send me the time, place, and repair list, and I’ll keep repeating it around the block so everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll send you the time, place, and repair list as soon as I finish matching everyone up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and help once I get there a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Dane. Just join us when you arrive, and I’ll keep the list clear so you can jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’ll do that and catch up as soon as I get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—Nell, I can bring the screwdrivers, wrench set, and whatever spare screws or bolts I can round up on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’m still catching up, so if you hear the final time and place, please send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Nell — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the final time and place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking whether the repair drive has started or if we’re just gathering donations. Once I confirm, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — I appreciate you checking. I might miss a detail here and there, so just keep me posted when you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I’ll double-check and let you know as soon as I confirm whether we’re still gathering donations or already fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping track of what we have for the repair drive, and I could use screws, duct tape, and a couple sturdy extension cords if you can spare them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Cleo — I’ll put you on the repair drive list and keep an eye out for those items. If you can, just let me know what time you’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll swing by later today and check in on the supplies. If anything else is still missing, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: After 4 still works for me — I’ll bring the screws and duct tape by then, and I’ll check on the extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll head to the community center on Maple by the side entrance and wait for you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I’ll meet you at the side entrance after 4 with the screws and duct tape, and I’ll bring the extension cords if I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. If you can grab the tools list, I can keep my part simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m confirming the tools list now, and I’ll send it over as soon as I have it locked in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep my part simple and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Early afternoon still works for me—just tell me what time you’re aiming for, and bringing everything to my place is easiest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, early afternoon works — let’s aim for 1 PM this Saturday at your place. I’ll bring the details and coordinate everyone from there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — 1 PM Saturday at my place works, and I’ll plan on you bringing the details. Just message me before you head over so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That still works for me—I can bring the screws and duct tape after 4, and I’ll message you before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Rey — after 4 works, and I’ll keep repeating that around the block so folks know where to go. Message me before you head over, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll do that — I’ll message you before I head over after 4.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking whether the repair drive has started or if we’re just gathering donations. Once I confirm, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — thanks for checking. Just let me know, and I can help spread the word either way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll confirm the status and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh sure, Bo — I’ve heard it’s coming together nicely, with folks already pitching in tools and time. If you want, I’ll keep an ear out for the next workday and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — just keep me posted on the next workday and I’ll come by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Bo — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the next workday. Hopefully they’ll have a good turnout again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — can you bring the hammer and screwdriver over when you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mina — I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver over when I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Gus. Are we still gathering donations for the repair drive, or has it started?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the exact drop-off details as soon as I finish confirming them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll head to the community center on Sunday and wait for the exact drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll send the exact drop-off details as soon as I’ve got them confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — if you can grab the tools list, that would help a lot. I’ll keep my part simple today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye out for the tools list and pass it along if I spot it. I might miss a detail or two, but I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — that’s plenty for me. I’ll stay on the simple part and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can add you to the repair drive invite list and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll swing by after 4 and help sort things out if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Ira — I’ve got you down for after 4. I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts, and thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right — I’m going to check the list again, then match each repair with someone and see what tools we still need. After that, I’ll pick a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m ready to take on the squeaky doors or a leaky faucet when you’ve got the list matched up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, Sam — I’ll match you to one of those once I recheck the list. If you’ve got any tools handy, bring them by and I’ll see what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering donations, and I’m checking inventory as we go. If you can spare screws, duct tape, or a sturdy extension cord, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can probably bring screws and a sturdy extension cord. Keep me posted if the pickup workday shifts at all.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’ll let you know right away if the pickup workday shifts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’m just waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: After 4 is best — I’ll bring it by the usual drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, after 4 at the usual drop-off spot — confirmed.
